topics.name: Linear Regression & Regression Analysis
topics.description: Foundation of supervised learning — from implementing OLS from scratch to regularized production regression systems.

levels.1: Implement simple linear regression from scratch using numpy. No libraries. Manual gradient descent, cost function, and visualization.
levels.2: Multiple linear regression on a real dataset (e.g., housing prices). Feature engineering, train/test split, evaluation metrics (MSE, R2, MAE), matplotlib plots.
levels.3: Production REST API for regression predictions. FastAPI endpoint, input validation with Pydantic, model serialization with joblib, logging, and unit tests.
levels.4: Regularized regression system (Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet). Cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning with Optuna, coefficient path visualization.
levels.5: Polynomial + interaction feature regression pipeline. Automated feature selection, VIF analysis, residual diagnostics, and a CLI interface.
levels.6: Bayesian linear regression with uncertainty quantification using PyMC. Posterior sampling, credible intervals, and comparison to frequentist OLS.
levels.7: Production-grade regression microservice with MLflow experiment tracking, model versioning, drift detection, and a Gradio dashboard.

topics.name: Statistics & Probability
topics.description: Core statistical foundations — from probability distributions to hypothesis testing engines.

levels.1: Probability distribution explorer: implement and visualize Normal, Binomial, Poisson, Exponential distributions from scratch with numpy.
levels.2: Statistical summary CLI tool: computes descriptive stats, detects outliers (IQR, Z-score), generates distribution fit reports on CSV data.
levels.3: Hypothesis testing engine: t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, Mann-Whitney U. FastAPI API accepting datasets and returning test results with p-values and effect sizes.
levels.4: Bootstrap confidence interval calculator with Monte Carlo simulation. Supports any custom statistic. Parallelized with concurrent.futures.
levels.5: Combined: Statistical regression diagnostics tool — integrates regression (Topic 1) with full residual analysis, normality tests, and heteroscedasticity detection.
levels.6: Bayesian inference engine from scratch: Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) with Metropolis-Hastings algorithm. Compare to scipy.stats benchmarks.
levels.7: Production statistical monitoring system: tracks data distributions over time, detects drift (KS test, PSI), sends alerts, logs to PostgreSQL.

topics.name: Advanced Statistics & Inference
topics.description: Graduate-level statistical methods — survival analysis, causal graphs, and multilevel modeling.

levels.1: Survival analysis toolkit: Kaplan-Meier estimator from scratch, log-rank test, hazard functions with lifelines validation.
levels.2: Propensity score matching for observational study analysis. Matching diagnostics, love plots, ATT/ATE estimation.
levels.3: Mixed-effects model API: longitudinal data analysis, random intercepts/slopes, model comparison (AIC/BIC). FastAPI + statsmodels.
levels.4: Structural equation modeling (SEM) implementation: path diagrams, latent variables, goodness-of-fit indices.
levels.5: Combined: Causal inference pipeline — DAG specification, backdoor criterion, do-calculus, propensity scoring, and regression adjustment in one system.
levels.6: Extreme value theory engine: Generalized Extreme Value (GEV) distribution fitting, return period estimation, risk quantification for financial/climate data.
levels.7: Full Bayesian hierarchical modeling system with PyMC: partial pooling, group-level effects, posterior predictive checks, and ARVIZ diagnostics dashboard.

topics.name: Linear Algebra for ML
topics.description: The mathematical backbone of all ML — from matrix operations to SVD-based algorithms.

levels.1: Matrix operations library from scratch: multiplication, inversion, determinant, LU decomposition — no numpy linear algebra allowed.
levels.2: Eigendecomposition explorer: power iteration, QR algorithm, visualizing eigenvectors/eigenvalues with animated matplotlib.
levels.3: SVD-based image compression tool: compress grayscale images at variable rank approximations, compare PSNR/SSIM metrics. CLI + FastAPI.
levels.4: PageRank algorithm implementation using power iteration and sparse matrix operations on real web graph data.
levels.5: Combined: Linear regression via SVD (pseudoinverse) vs OLS vs gradient descent — performance benchmark and numerical stability analysis.
levels.6: Numba-accelerated linear algebra library: JIT-compiled matrix operations outperforming numpy for specific dimensions. Benchmarking suite.
levels.7: Randomized SVD engine (a la sklearn's TruncatedSVD) with NYSTROM approximation for kernel matrices — production-grade with memory profiling.

topics.name: PCA & Dimensionality Reduction
topics.description: From classical PCA to modern manifold learning — dimensionality reduction for visualization and ML pipelines.

levels.1: PCA from scratch using eigendecomposition. Explained variance, scree plots, 2D/3D projections on IRIS and MNIST.
levels.2: Dimensionality reduction comparison tool: PCA vs t-SNE vs UMAP on multiple datasets. Interactive Plotly visualizations.
levels.3: Production feature reduction pipeline: PCA preprocessing → model training → inverse transform reconstruction. FastAPI with sklearn Pipeline.
levels.4: Kernel PCA with multiple kernels (RBF, poly, sigmoid). Non-linear manifold learning benchmarks on Swiss roll and S-curve datasets.
levels.5: Combined: Regression + PCA pipeline — reduce high-dimensional features, then apply regularized regression. Compare performance vs raw features.
levels.6: Autoencoder-based dimensionality reduction with PyTorch. Variational autoencoder (VAE) variant for generative embeddings.
levels.7: Production embedding service: UMAP + HNSW approximate nearest neighbor search. FastAPI, Redis caching, batch processing for 1M+ vectors.

topics.name: Classification Algorithms
topics.description: Core classification algorithms from scratch to production — binary, multiclass, and imbalanced scenarios.

levels.1: Logistic regression from scratch: sigmoid, binary cross-entropy loss, gradient descent, decision boundary visualization.
levels.2: Multi-algorithm classifier comparison: LR, SVM, kNN, Naive Bayes, Decision Tree on multiple datasets. ROC curves, confusion matrices.
levels.3: Production classification API with probability calibration (Platt scaling, isotonic). Threshold optimization for precision/recall tradeoff.
levels.4: Imbalanced classification system: SMOTE, ADASYN, cost-sensitive learning, ensemble balancing. Medical dataset (fraud/disease).
levels.5: Combined: PCA + SVM pipeline for high-dimensional text classification. Dimensionality reduction → kernel SVM → Platt calibration.
levels.6: Multi-label classification system: Label Powerset, Binary Relevance, Classifier Chains. Hierarchical label taxonomy support.
levels.7: Production classifier microservice: online learning (SGD), concept drift detection, automatic retraining triggers, MLflow logging, k8s-ready.

topics.name: Ensemble Methods & Boosting
topics.description: State-of-the-art tabular ML — from bagging to gradient boosting to model stacking.

levels.1: Random forest from scratch: decision stumps, bagging, OOB error. Compare to sklearn RandomForest.
levels.2: Gradient boosting from scratch: residual fitting, learning rate, tree depth. Validate against XGBoost.
levels.3: AutoML-lite for tabular data: trains XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost, auto-tunes with Optuna, returns best model as API.
levels.4: Stacking ensemble framework: Level-0 diverse models (GBM, RF, LR, SVM), Level-1 meta-learner. Cross-validation blending.
levels.5: Combined: Boosting + feature importance pipeline — SHAP explanations, partial dependence plots, feature selection loop.
levels.6: Distributed XGBoost training with Dask: scale to datasets larger than RAM. Comparison vs single-node benchmarks.
levels.7: Production tabular ML platform: data ingestion, feature store, ensemble training, SHAP explainability API, monitoring, scheduled retraining.

topics.name: Clustering & Unsupervised Learning
topics.description: Finding hidden structure in data — from k-means to density-based clustering to mixture models.

levels.1: K-means from scratch: Lloyd's algorithm, elbow method, silhouette analysis, animated convergence visualization.
levels.2: Clustering algorithm zoo: K-Means, DBSCAN, Agglomerative, GMM, HDBSCAN compared on multiple synthetic and real datasets.
levels.3: Customer segmentation pipeline: RFM features, clustering, cluster profiling, and a FastAPI endpoint for real-time segment assignment.
levels.4: Gaussian Mixture Model from scratch: EM algorithm, BIC/AIC model selection, density estimation vs KDE comparison.
levels.5: Combined: PCA + clustering pipeline — reduce dimensions, cluster, interpret clusters in original feature space with centroid back-projection.
levels.6: Anomaly detection system: Isolation Forest + DBSCAN + LOF ensemble. Real-time scoring API with configurable thresholds and alert webhooks.
levels.7: Production clustering microservice: online clustering (Mini-Batch K-Means), concept drift detection, automatic re-clustering triggers, Prometheus metrics.

topics.name: Computer Vision
topics.description: From classical image processing to modern deep CNNs — production-grade vision systems.

levels.1: Classical CV toolkit: edge detection (Sobel, Canny), morphological ops, histogram equalization from scratch with OpenCV.
levels.2: Image classification pipeline: ResNet-18 fine-tuned on custom dataset. Data augmentation, transfer learning, evaluation dashboard.
levels.3: Object detection API: YOLOv8 inference endpoint. FastAPI + async processing, bounding box visualization, confidence filtering.
levels.4: Semantic segmentation system: U-Net trained on satellite/medical imagery. Custom loss (Dice + BCE), mIoU evaluation.
levels.5: Combined: CV + statistics — image quality assessment pipeline using SSIM, PSNR, BRISQUE, with statistical outlier detection.
levels.6: Real-time video analytics pipeline: multi-object tracking (ByteTrack), re-ID, trajectory analysis, async frame processing with Redis queue.
levels.7: Production CV microservice: model ensemble (detection + classification + segmentation), TensorRT optimization, FastAPI, Prometheus, k8s-ready.

topics.name: NLP & Text Processing
topics.description: From classical NLP to transformer-based production systems.

levels.1: Text preprocessing pipeline from scratch: tokenization, stemming, lemmatization, TF-IDF, cosine similarity — no NLTK/spaCy internals.
levels.2: Sentiment analysis system: classical ML (TF-IDF + LR) vs fine-tuned BERT. Benchmark on multiple datasets, explainability with LIME.
levels.3: Production NLP API: Named Entity Recognition, POS tagging, dependency parsing with spaCy. FastAPI, batch processing, caching.
levels.4: Document embedding search engine: Sentence-BERT + FAISS approximate nearest neighbor. Semantic search API for document corpus.
levels.5: Combined: NLP + clustering — topic modeling with BERTopic, automatic taxonomy generation, topic drift monitoring over time.
levels.6: Fine-tuned LLM for domain-specific QA: LoRA fine-tuning on custom corpus, RLHF-lite with DPO, evaluation with ROUGE/BERTScore.
levels.7: Production RAG pipeline: document ingestion, chunking strategies, hybrid search (BM25 + dense), reranking, hallucination detection, FastAPI.

topics.name: Time Series Analysis & Forecasting
topics.description: From classical ARIMA to neural forecasting — production-grade time series systems.

levels.1: Time series decomposition from scratch: trend, seasonality, residuals (STL). ACF/PACF plots, stationarity tests (ADF, KPSS).
levels.2: ARIMA/SARIMA forecasting pipeline: auto-identification of p,d,q, rolling forecast, confidence intervals, benchmark vs naive methods.
levels.3: Multi-model forecasting API: Prophet, ARIMA, ETS, Theta method ensemble. FastAPI endpoint, uncertainty quantification.
levels.4: LSTM time series forecaster from scratch with PyTorch. Sequence-to-sequence, attention mechanism, comparison vs statistical baselines.
levels.5: Combined: Time series + anomaly detection — SARIMA residual monitoring, CUSUM changepoint detection, alert webhook system.
levels.6: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) for multivariate forecasting: known/unknown covariates, interpretable attention weights, MLflow tracking.
levels.7: Production forecasting platform: hierarchical reconciliation (MinT), probabilistic forecasts, retraining pipeline, drift detection, Grafana dashboard.

topics.name: Recommendation Systems
topics.description: From collaborative filtering to production-grade deep recommendation engines.

levels.1: User-based collaborative filtering from scratch: cosine similarity, neighborhood selection, prediction on MovieLens.
levels.2: Matrix factorization comparison: SVD, ALS, NMF on implicit feedback data. Coverage, novelty, and diversity metrics.
levels.3: Production recommendation API: ALS model with implicit library. FastAPI, user/item cold-start handling, A/B test logging.
levels.4: Neural collaborative filtering: embedding layers, MLP interaction, BPR loss. Benchmarked vs matrix factorization.
levels.5: Combined: NLP + recommendations — content-based filtering using BERT embeddings for item descriptions, hybrid with CF.
levels.6: Two-tower retrieval model: separate user/item towers, FAISS for ANN retrieval, online learning updates.
levels.7: Production recommendation platform: retrieval (ANN) + ranking (XGBoost) pipeline, feature store, A/B test framework, real-time serving.

topics.name: Deep Learning
topics.description: From building backprop from scratch to training transformer architectures.

levels.1: Neural network from scratch (no PyTorch): forward pass, backpropagation, chain rule, weight updates on XOR and MNIST.
levels.2: CNN from scratch with PyTorch: conv layers, pooling, batch norm, dropout, trained on CIFAR-10 with learning rate scheduling.
levels.3: Custom training framework: gradient checkpointing, mixed precision (torch.amp), gradient clipping, experiment logging to W&B.
levels.4: Attention mechanism from scratch: scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, positional encoding — validated against PyTorch nn.MultiheadAttention.
levels.5: Combined: Deep Learning + CV — Vision Transformer (ViT) from scratch, fine-tuned on a medical imaging dataset, GRAD-CAM explainability.
levels.6: Distributed training with PyTorch DDP: multi-GPU training, gradient synchronization, profiling with torch.profiler, FSDP for large models.
levels.7: Production deep learning serving: model quantization (INT8/FP16), TorchScript, ONNX export, FastAPI + async batching, latency benchmarks.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning
topics.description: From tabular Q-learning to deep RL in production environments.

levels.1: Tabular Q-learning from scratch on GridWorld and FrozenLake. Policy visualization, convergence plots, epsilon-greedy exploration.
levels.2: Deep Q-Network (DQN) from scratch: experience replay, target network, epsilon decay. Train on CartPole and LunarLander.
levels.3: Policy gradient methods: REINFORCE, Actor-Critic (A2C) from scratch. Compare sample efficiency on continuous control tasks.
levels.4: PPO implementation from scratch: clipped objective, generalized advantage estimation (GAE), entropy bonus. Train on MuJoCo.
levels.5: Combined: RL + Deep Learning — train a CNN policy for visual navigation tasks (MiniGrid). Image observations, reward shaping.
levels.6: Multi-agent RL system with RLlib: cooperative and competitive environments, centralized training, decentralized execution (CTDE).
levels.7: Production RL system: offline RL (CQL/IQL) on logged data, policy evaluation (OPE), safe policy deployment with constraint satisfaction.

topics.name: Operations Research & Optimization
topics.description: Mathematical optimization from linear programming to evolutionary algorithms.

levels.1: Simplex method from scratch: tableau form, pivot operations, degeneracy handling, minimization/maximization.
levels.2: Production LP solver: supply chain optimization with PuLP/OR-Tools. Multi-objective formulation, sensitivity analysis.
levels.3: Integer programming solver API: scheduling/assignment problems. FastAPI, problem definition in JSON, Gurobi/GLPK backend.
levels.4: Genetic algorithm framework from scratch: selection, crossover, mutation, fitness landscape visualization. TSP application.
levels.5: Combined: Statistics + Optimization — stochastic programming, chance constraints, Monte Carlo for robust optimization.
levels.6: Convex optimization engine with CVXPY: portfolio optimization, LASSO/Ridge as convex programs, custom solvers.
levels.7: Production optimization platform: online optimization (bandit algorithms), constraint learning from data, API with warm-starting and solution caching.

topics.name: A/B Testing & Causal Inference
topics.description: Rigorous experiment design and causal analysis for data-driven decisions.

levels.1: A/B test engine from scratch: z-test, t-test, chi-square for proportions, power/sample size calculator.
levels.2: Bayesian A/B testing: Beta-Binomial model, posterior distributions, expected loss, probability of being best.
levels.3: Production A/B test platform: experiment registration, traffic splitting, real-time stats with sequential testing (mSPRT), FastAPI.
levels.4: Multi-armed bandit system: Thompson Sampling, UCB1, Epsilon-Greedy. Regret analysis, contextual bandits with LinUCB.
levels.5: Combined: Causal inference + regression — DID (Difference-in-Differences), synthetic control, IV estimation on observational data.
levels.6: Uplift modeling system: S-learner, T-learner, X-learner, causal forest. Qini curves, AUUC evaluation, treatment effect visualization.
levels.7: Production causal ML platform: DAG specification, identification, estimation (DoWhy), refutation tests, and a decision recommendation API.

topics.name: Graph ML & Graph Neural Networks
topics.description: From classical graph algorithms to production GNN systems.

levels.1: Graph algorithm library from scratch: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, PageRank, centrality measures with NetworkX validation.
levels.2: Node embedding: Node2Vec, DeepWalk, LINE on citation/social graphs. Downstream classification with embeddings.
levels.3: GCN from scratch with PyTorch: message passing, aggregation, readout. Node/graph classification on Cora and MUTAG.
levels.4: Graph Attention Network (GAT): attention coefficients, multi-head attention, comparison vs GCN/GraphSAGE.
levels.5: Combined: GNN + NLP — heterogeneous graph of documents, entities, and relations. Link prediction for knowledge graph completion.
levels.6: Scalable GNN with GraphSAGE + neighbor sampling. Training on full ogbn-products dataset without full-graph materialization.
levels.7: Production GNN serving: dynamic graph updates, incremental embedding refresh, FAISS ANN for graph-based retrieval, FastAPI.

topics.name: MLOps & Production ML
topics.description: End-to-end ML system design — pipelines, monitoring, and production deployment.

levels.1: ML experiment tracker from scratch: log parameters, metrics, artifacts to SQLite. CLI and Python API.
levels.2: DVC data versioning pipeline: data download, preprocessing, feature engineering, model training — all as tracked pipeline stages.
levels.3: Dockerized ML API: FastAPI model server, Docker Compose with Redis cache, health checks, structured logging with structlog.
levels.4: Airflow ML pipeline: data ingestion → preprocessing → training → evaluation → conditional deployment DAG.
levels.5: Combined: MLOps + ensemble — automated model comparison pipeline, champion/challenger deployment, shadow mode testing.
levels.6: Model monitoring system: feature drift (KS, PSI), prediction drift, data quality checks, Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, alert rules.
levels.7: Full MLOps platform: feature store (Feast), experiment tracking (MLflow), model registry, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, k8s deployment with Helm.

topics.name: LLM & RAG Systems
topics.description: Modern LLM application development — RAG pipelines, agents, and fine-tuning.

levels.1: RAG from scratch: document chunking, TF-IDF retrieval, prompt construction, LLM generation — no LangChain.
levels.2: Vector store RAG: embed with Sentence-BERT, store in ChromaDB/FAISS, retrieve + rerank, stream LLM response.
levels.3: Production RAG API: hybrid search (BM25 + dense), reranking (cross-encoder), hallucination scoring, FastAPI + async.
levels.4: Agentic RAG with LangGraph: tool-using agent, multi-hop reasoning, self-reflection loop, citation tracking.
levels.5: Combined: RAG + NLP — document structure extraction, hierarchical chunking, entity-aware retrieval, table/figure handling.
levels.6: LLM fine-tuning pipeline: dataset preparation, LoRA/QLoRA training with TRL, evaluation (MMLU, custom evals), model merging.
levels.7: Production LLM platform: multi-model routing, prompt caching, guardrails (hallucination + toxicity), cost tracking, full observability.

topics.name: Multi-Agent AI Systems
topics.description: State-of-the-art autonomous agent architectures — from simple ReAct loops to multi-agent production systems.

levels.1: ReAct agent from scratch: thought-action-observation loop, custom tool registry, search + calculator + code tools.
levels.2: Specialized agent team: researcher + writer + critic agents with LangGraph orchestration and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
levels.3: Production agent API: tool-using FastAPI agent, streaming responses, conversation memory (Redis), rate limiting.
levels.4: Durable long-running agent: checkpointing, resumability after failure, quota-aware execution, audit log.
levels.5: Combined: Agent + MLOps — autonomous ML engineer agent that proposes experiments, runs them, and reports results.
levels.6: Multi-agent swarm: parallel sub-agents with task decomposition, result aggregation, conflict resolution, supervisor pattern.
levels.7: Production multi-agent platform: agent registry, capability discovery, inter-agent communication protocol (MCP), monitoring, cost governance.
